verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents creating a team-scoped API key for SDK and raw HTTP API use. That is a product-issued credential with some scoping, but nothing shows finer-grained permissions, per-agent keys, or resource-level restrictions that would make it truly least-privilege. The credential features in docs-15 cover injecting outbound secrets into a sandbox, an adjacent capability that is not credited here. Missing for 10: granular permission scopes (read-only vs. write, per-sandbox or per-template), per-agent key issuance, key expiry/rotation/revocation docs, independent corroboration.
